notes: ACL 2025 demo paper. o3-mini appears as one of several QA systems scored on ScholarQA-CS, but every score in Table 2/6 depends on gpt-4o-2024-08-06 or gpt-4o-2024-11-20 as the LLM judge, neither of which is on the still-callable list. A separate, role-A use of gpt-4-turbo (relevance labeling for retrieval tuning, 80% agreement with humans on 100 queries, Sec. 4.1) is not the paper's benchmarked subject either.
